item.title: UPDATE: Georgia General Assembly approves medical marijuana vaping and removing THC limits - Moultrie Observer
item.description: In the 11 years since Georgia’s medical marijuana program started, it has slowly stumbled forward, with patients restricted to low-potency oils.

item.title: SRTC appoints new board member Andrew Sheffield - Moultrie Observer
item.description: Southern Regional Technical College President Jim Glass recently announced the addition of Andrew Sheffield of Bainbridge to the SRTC Board of Directors.

item.title: Mother Easter to host ASU gospel choir - Moultrie Observer
item.description: The Performing Arts Ministry of Mother Easter Baptist Church presents The Anointed Gospel Choir of Albany State University this Saturday.

item.title: High school cellphone ban heads to Georgia governor's desk - Moultrie Observer
item.description: Cellphones will be banned in Georgia public high schools starting in the 2027-28 school year, if Gov. Brian Kemp signs House Bill 1009 into law.

item.title: Georgia lawmakers pass bill penalizing protests that block roads - Moultrie Observer
item.description: The Georgia House voted Monday to impose tougher punishments on protesters who block streets, approving the bill over objections from legislators who said it infringes on free speech rights.

item.title: Georgians may be able to forgo observing Daylight Saving Time - Moultrie Observer
item.description: Residents of the State Georgia will not have to “spring forward” or “fall back” if HB 154 is put into effect.

item.title: Colquitt golfers fourth in Tifton, prepare for Packer Invitational - Moultrie Observer
item.description: The Colquitt County golf team shot a 302 good for fourth place in the Blue Devil Invitational held on Monday at Spring Hill Country Club in Tifton.

item.title: TERRY TURNER: Powers of the President—or not - Moultrie Observer
item.description: The Constitution of the United States took effect on July 21, 1788. It applied to the thirteen former British colonies that had previously suffered through six years of war of rebellion against Britain.

item.title: Moss Farms divers compete in Carolina Big Dive - Moultrie Observer
item.description: Moss Farms divers Amelia Gregory, Beck Gregory and Selah Huante brought gold medals back from the recent Carolina Big Dive.
